records.title: Introducing VEIL Research Project
records.original_text:
🔬 INTRODUCING VEIL RESEARCH PROJECT
Exploring the unexplained through science, technology, and evidence.

Today marks an exciting milestone: the establishment of VEIL Research Project's official Facebook presence.

I'm Andrew Underwood, Founder & Lead Researcher of VEIL Research Project, an emerging independent research initiative dedicated to investigating reported anomalous environmental phenomena through scientifically controlled experimentation.

OUR VISION
To develop a scientifically credible research program combining advanced instrumentation, synchronized environmental sensors, artificial intelligence, and carefully designed experimental protocols.

Our proposed research includes:
🔹 Environmental monitoring and unexplained phenomena
🔹 Electromagnetic field research
🔹 Advanced thermal and optical detection systems
🔹 Experimental communication and recording technologies
🔹 AI-assisted scientific observation and analysis
🔹 Investigation of unconventional but testable

We are currently developing our research methodologies, experimental concepts, and technical plans while pursuing opportunities for scientific collaboration and development.

Join us here:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/1637421824686165

OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLE
"We do not set out to prove the paranormal exists. We set out to discover what the evidence reveals."

The journey begins with questions. Where the evidence takes us remains to be discovered.

Andrew Underwood
Founder & Lead Researcher
VEIL Research Project

#VEILResearchProject #ScientificResearch #ExperimentalScience #AnomalousPhenomena #ResearchInnovation

records.title: Welcome to VEIL Research Community
records.original_text:
🔬 WELCOME TO VEIL RESEARCH COMMUNITY
Exploring the unexplained through science, technology, and evidence.

Welcome to the official discussion community of VEIL Research Project, founded by Andrew Underwood, Founder & Research Director.

VEIL is an emerging independent research initiative dedicated to investigating reported anomalous phenomena through controlled experimentation, advanced instrumentation, synchronized sensors, and AI-assisted analysis.

WHAT WE EXPLORE
🔹 Unexplained and reported paranormal events
🔹 Experimental research and scientific investigation
🔹 Electromagnetic and environmental phenomena
🔹 Innovative instruments and detection technologies
🔹 Unconventional theories and testable hypotheses
🔹 Artificial intelligence in scientific research

OUR PHILOSOPHY
We welcome unusual experiences, challenging questions, and unconventional ideas. However, we distinguish observations from interpretations and hypotheses from established findings.
We encourage scientific scrutiny, alternative explanations, and respectful debate.

OUR COMMUNITY STANDARDS
This group is publicly viewable, but posting and commenting require approved participation.
All posts are reviewed. Clickbait, promotional quizzes, fabricated announcements, scams, prize or money giveaways, and deliberate deception are strictly prohibited. Confirmed violations result in immediate permanent bans.

OUR MISSION
"We do not set out to prove the paranormal exists. We set out to discover what the evidence reveals."
We invite scientists, researchers, engineers, investigators, inventors, and curious minds to join us in asking better questions and developing better ways to investigate them.

Welcome to VEIL Research Community.

— Andrew Underwood
Founder & Research Director
VEIL Research Project

records.title: Mirror image with conflicting locations
records.original_text: We've been researching this photograph at VEIL Research Project, and we've uncovered something interesting. Using Google Lens, we located multiple appearances of this same image, including search results dating back to February 2019. What's particularly interesting is that the descriptions have changed over time. The photograph has been associated with a nursing home, an abandoned house, a former nunnery, and even a hotel. One possible natural explanation is deterioration of the reflective coating behind an older mirror, which can create permanent, face-like patterns. We're not dismissing anyone's experience, but we believe investigating the history of an image is just as important as examining what appears in it. Does anyone know who originally photographed this mirror or where it was located? VEIL Research Project https://veilresearchproject.github.io/veil-research-project/

records.title: Photo artifact and reverse-image history review
records.original_text: Interesting photograph! We've been tracing its history at VEIL Research Project using reverse-image searches. Our search uncovered appearances associated with dates as far back as 2008, and we independently located a September 2014 paranormal article discussing this same photograph and its accompanying story. One possibility worth investigating is a photographic artifact caused by flash illumination, a nearby object, or camera movement. We're interested in identifying the original photographer and obtaining the original image rather than relying on the stories attached to later reposts. Does anyone know who originally captured this photograph? At VEIL, we believe every unexplained image deserves investigation before interpretation. https://veilresearchproject.github.io/veil-research-project/

The cited investigation is an account reported in the reply.
